name: revenuedot-docs
description: RevenueDot documentation: Markdown pages, the OpenAPI document and the scripts that generate and check them.

scripts.build: npm run build:openapi && npm run build:api && npm run build:errors && npm run build:llms
scripts.check: npm run lint:openapi && npm run check:drift && npm run check:pages && npm run check:errors && npm run check:links
scripts.all: npm run build && npm run check
